title: Marketing Manager
description:
We're working with a well-established UK training / development business to hire a Senior Marketing Manager to own the growth plan, lead targets, and go hands-on across the key demand channels.

This is a true "lead it, and do it" role: you'll set the marketing direction across multiple product lines, while personally driving performance across search, website conversion, and database/lifecycle marketing. You'll also lead and develop a Marketing & Growth Manager (who oversees day-to-day activity with solid foundations already in place).

Role: Senior Marketing Manager
Location: Liverpool Centre (Hybrid)
Type: Permanent
Salary: DOA

Key responsibilities include:
- Own the marketing strategy and annual plan (agreed with directors) across multiple business lines
- Take full ownership of the lead target and where budget/effort should be allocated to hit it
- Drive demand generation hands-on: SEO/AEO, website optimisation and conversion rate improvement
- Maximise value from an existing CRM/database: segmentation, comms, nurture journeys, cross-sell/upsell lead generation
- Develop positioning and messaging that resonates with senior decision-makers
- Produce monthly performance reporting (HubSpot) demonstrating marketing impact on pipeline
- Lead through others: manage and develop a Marketing & Growth Manager

Key skills and experience:
- Senior B2 B marketing experience with a track record of generating qualified leads for "considered purchase" services
- Strong, hands-on capability in search (SEO/AEO) and website conversion
- Lifecycle / CRM / database marketing experience (nurture, segmentation, repeat/cross-sell)
- Confidence using HubSpot and turning data into clear commercial decisions
- "AI-first" mindset and curiosity-able to adapt as search shifts towards AI-led answers
- Strong commercial judgement and ability to write credible, compelling copy for senior audiences
- Proven people leadership (developing a manager)

title: Paid Media Specialist
description:
Join the Party - We're Looking for a Paid Media Specialist!

Location: Liverpool City Centre (Hybrid)
Salary: 32,000 - 40,000, dependent on experience + bonus opportunities

Zachary Daniels Recruitment is delighted to be partnering with a leading entertainment and hospitality group that has taken the UK and international event scene by storm.

We're looking for an experienced Paid Media Specialist to take ownership of paid media activity across a fast-moving, high-energy brand.

With an always-on calendar spanning 40+ venues, seasonal campaigns, new launches and brand collaborations, this is a fantastic opportunity for someone who enjoys being hands-on and seeing the direct impact of their work.

You'll own paid media end-to-end - from strategy and budget allocation through to campaign execution, optimisation and reporting.

Key Responsibilities:
- Own paid media strategy across 40+ venues, seasonal campaigns and key launches.
- Build, launch and optimise campaigns across Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, Pinterest, Google Ads and Performance Max.
- Manage budgets across venues and campaigns to maximise performance.
- React quickly to sold-out events, new on-sales and schedule or venue changes.
- Run structured test-and-learn programmes across creative, audiences and bidding.
- Optimise campaigns against agreed KPIs including CPA and ROAS.
- Deliver weekly and monthly reporting using GA4 and attribution data.
- Work closely with Design, Video, Organic Social and CRM teams on campaign delivery.
- Support the expansion into YouTube and explore emerging channels and formats.
- Manage relationships with key platform partners including Meta, TikTok and Google.

What We're Looking For:
- 4+ years' paid media experience, agencyside or in-house.
- Strong hands-on experience across Meta and TikTok, with Snapchat, Pinterest and/or Google experience desirable.
- Confidence owning paid media from strategy through to execution and reporting.
- Strong working knowledge of Ads Manager platforms.
- A data-led mindset with experience using GA4 and reporting tools such as Looker Studio.
- Experience in a fast-paced, high-volume campaign environment.
- Strong understanding of ROAS, CPA, LTV and Share of Voice.
- Comfortable using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Codex or Claude to improve productivity and campaign performance.

Nice to Have:
- Google Ads / Performance Max experience.
- Experience in events, hospitality, entertainment or nightlife.
- Experience managing monthly paid media budgets of 30,000+.

What's in it for You?
- A four-day work week.
- Hybrid working from Liverpool city centre.
- 32,000 - 40,000 salary, dependent on experience.
- Bonus opportunities.
- Complimentary event tickets.
- A fast-paced, creative environment with real ownership and impact.
- Regular team socials and a fun, innovative culture.

If you're an experienced Paid Media Specialist who loves being hands-on, thrives in a fast-moving environment and wants to take real ownership of paid media, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now and let's talk!

BBH: 37443
